newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends 1.8 higher at 1,001.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends 1.8 higher at 1,001.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 1.8 higher at 1,001 but off its intraday high of 998.45 to the dollar in active trading on the country's interbank market.

Dealers said dollar sales by exporters, especially from the oil sector, had given support to the peso most of the day and helped it pierce the psychological barrier of 1,000-to-one with little trouble early in the session.
It gave up some of its early gains on speculative dollar- buying by banks late in the trading day, however.
Dealers reported an above-average 398 trades for a total of $158.1 million and said the peso's intraday low was 1,001.50
